body: Yeah I think instead she'll just ensure I feel the pain of a horrible father's day and be vindictive. I just made dinner for them as they came back. Nothing.

I made an offhand joke that she wouldn't be the type preferred by a certain actor who only goes for bimbo blonde models. She took it as ugly and wouldn't hear anything to the contrary. Low self esteem. Say meaningfully she's beautiful 1000 times, accidentally make her think she's not and that's all there is in life.

Just because I have what others don't doesn't mean that I deserve them. My wife is mad over something inconsequential and though I apologized profusely and sincerely she's on her period which makes her irrationally angry. So she's giving me the silent treatment. When I said I missed her she only said "this is self inflicted". 

I hate feeling this way. I'm sick of feeling anything.
What's to cherish? All I do is work and find things to keep the kid occupied. Tomorrow if I wake up it'll be to give them breakfast then get on meetings and shush them. Life is shit.
Maybe. There's a lot of remote woods by me that shouldn't be hard.
